title: Electorate of Baden
capsule: The Electorate of Baden was an electoral dignity granted to Margrave Karl Friedrich of Baden by Napoleon's reorganization of Germany under the Reichsdeputationshauptschluss of 1803, rewarding Baden's French alignment with large territorial gains from secularized ecclesiastical territories and elevating it to an electorate of the moribund Empire. The rank lasted only until 1806 when Napoleon's dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire rendered it obsolete; simultaneously Karl Friedrich was raised to Grand Duke of Baden within the Confederation of the Rhine. The three-year electoral interval thus marks a transitional constitutional moment rather than a distinct long-term territorial regime.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution.
